title: a project that never adopted JITSO gets warnings for the hook, the skill and the instructions, and no failure
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). On the default project (a catalog, no hook, no skill, no instruction block) doctor exits 0: `warn hooks: not registered`, `warn skill-project: not installed`, `warn instructions: ...`, `ok   catalog: ...`, and not one `fail` line. A warning never breaks a script. The oracle has no `doctor` command: it answers `unknown command "doctor"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every pinned line FAILS on it.
